issues.detail: The unstaged documentation record already spells out the AC-005 errata dependency and ends with 'settle the route for the active recovery frame'. The prompt states this dependency as a fact, so recording it is legitimate. It does not name the corrective-return route, the owner, or the evidence still required, so the role still has to decide the route and complete the persisted dependency. It makes the case somewhat easier but does not leak the answer.

.standards/CONTEXT.md says docs/operator-guide.md 'has not changed since the initial commit'. This was true at audit time and is stale after the first documentation pass. It is a normal Auditor snapshot and is harmless.

summary: The fixture realizes every stated condition. It has a DOCUMENTATION cycle in DOCUMENTING with the specified frame, a verified unstaged guide correction, and an interrupted IN_PROGRESS final review. Its remaining AC-005 errata entry is blocked solely by a project convention that forbids entries until the review finishes. I traced check.mjs: both the built state and the expected RESUME-to-REVIEWING_FINAL end state with an IN_PROGRESS record pass. The checks ('/reviewer' reply, untouched review report, Status not COMPLETE, not FORWARD) are necessary conditions that no correct run would fail.
